title: Comrade Detective
description: Lost Romanian series recently remastered and dubbed, originally created to celebrate and promote Communist ideals. Troubled police detective Gregor Anghel’s partner is murdered. He and his new partner investigate, uncovering a sinister, capitalist plot by the West.
quote: You don’t become a good Communist by going to meetings. You do it on the streets. You do it with your fists.
altHero: detective Gregor Anghel walking down the street, wearing sunglasses and a leather jacket
alt1: Gregor in the car on a stakeout with his partner
alt2: binocular view of a man in a mask holding his partner hostage
alt3: two detectives with trophies clap at Gregor and his new partner while they are looking at a Monopoly board
alt4: beat-up man in a hospital bed raising his hands during an interview
